title: GatePacket
description: What a human reviewer receives at the Captain's Gate. The packet must answer, without further enquiry: what changed, why, by whom, on what model, through what tools, on what evidence, at what cost, and how to reverse it.

ready_for_decision.description: False whenever any blocking evidence failed. A packet that is not ready cannot be approved.

cost.description: Metered spend by dimension. Currency defaults to SGD.

reversal.description: The tested way back. An empty reversal blocks deployment.

branches.description: Competing candidates, each separately costed and tested.
